blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Interpretable Transformers often perform well in domain specific settings but lose effectiveness beyond that. Achieving ViT-like broad applicability requires models with consistent performance across domains. Recent works on Interpretable Transformers, INTR and Prompt-CAM, were developed keeping domain adaptability in mind. Prompt-CAM leverages learnable prompts to promote adaptability. However, these prompts are fixed in nature and therefore struggle to adapt to domains with substantial variation in input image characteristics, resulting in reduced interpretability. To address this limitation, we propose INTR++, which extends Prompt-CAM by incorporating a lightweight Prompt Adapter Module (PAM). PAM enables prompts to be adaptive by enriching them with domain-specific knowledge, thereby ensuring consistent interpretability across diverse domains including those with varying image characteristics such as medical imaging, micro-scopic imaging, and remote sensing imagery. INTR++ retains the standard architecture and end-to-end learning of Interpretable Transformer based models, while adding only a small number of additional parameters compared to Prompt-CAM. We demonstrate that INTR++ delivers consistent improvements in all aspects across domains like animals, plants, medical imaging, microscopic imaging, remote sensing imagery and object-centric data.
blocks.zh: 可解释的变形器在域特定设置中往往表现良好,但丧失了超出域的效能. 实现类似虚拟技术的广泛适用性,需要具有各领域一致业绩的模式。 最近关于可解释变换器、INTR和即时-CAM的著作是在铭记域适应性的情况下开发的。 快速-CAM杠杆可以学习,促进适应性。 然而,这些提示在性质上是固定的,因此难以适应输入图像特性差异很大的域,导致可解释性降低. 为了解决这一限制,我们提议INTR++,通过纳入一个轻量级的即时适配器模块(PAM)来扩展即时CAM。 PAM通过丰富特定领域的知识,使提示具有适应性,从而确保不同领域的一致解释性,包括具有不同图像特征的领域,如医学成像、微镜成像和遥感成像。 INTR++保留了以可解释变形器为基础的模型的标准架构和端到端的学习,而与"Poan-CAM"相比,仅添加了少量的额外参数. 我们证明,INTR++在动物、植物、医疗成像、显微镜成像、遥感成像和以物体为中心的数据等各个领域的各方面都取得了一致的改进。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
Interpretable Transformers [ 31 , 6 , 25 ] have recently gained significant attention due to their standard architectures and end-to-end learning strategies. These methods have demonstrated strong interpretability across diverse domains such as animals, plants, and object-centric datasets. We refer to these as domains with natural image input. However, their adaptability to medical imaging, and microscopic imaging is limited. This limitation arises from the substantial variation in the image characteristics compared to natural images, and we refer to such domains as those with specialized image input. Existing Interpretable Transformer methods exhibit a decline in its adaptability
when transitioning from domains with natural image input to those with specialized image input.
blocks.zh:
最近,可解释的变形器[31,6,25]因其标准架构和端到端的学习策略而获得极大关注. 这些方法已显示出在动物、植物和以物体为中心的数据集等不同领域具有强有力的可解释性。 我们把这些称为有自然图像输入的域。 然而,它们对医疗成像和显微成像的适应性有限。 这一限制产生于图像特性与自然图像相比有很大差异,我们提到的领域有专门的图像输入。 现有可解释变换器方法的适应性下降
当从具有自然图像输入的域向具有专门图像输入的域过渡时。

blocks.en: Beyond adaptability, another critical limitation lies in their classification performance. Although these methods demonstrate strong interpretability in domains with natural images, they often struggle to deliver high predictive accuracy. This shortcoming is commonly observed in prompt-based Interpretable Transformers [ 6 ] , where the class-specific prompts lack the capacity to capture fine-grained localized information essential for accurate prediction. This is due to the static nature of the prompts. By static , we mean prompts that are learned solely through the attention mechanism of the frozen backbone. In contrast, we refer to prompts as adaptive when they are learned not only through the backbone but also through an adapter module, enriching them with domain-specific knowledge.
blocks.zh: 除了适应性外,另一个关键限制在于它们的分类性能. 虽然这些方法在具有自然图像的域中表现出强烈的可解释性,但它们往往难以提供高预测准确性. 这一缺陷通常出现在即时的可解释变换器[6]中,该类的特异性提示缺乏捕捉精确预测所必需的精细的局部信息的能力. 这是因为提示的静态性. 通过静态,我们是指完全通过冷冻骨干 的注意机制来学习的提示。 与此相反,我们称提示是适应性的,不仅通过骨干,而且通过适配器模块学习,用特定领域的知识丰富它们。

blocks.en: This highlights the need for Interpretable Transformers that effectively handle the trade-off between classification performance and interpretability irrespective of the input image type. Limitations in existing models stem from the frozen backbone, which restricts the prompts from becoming truly adaptive. Nevertheless, these backbones still encode useful spatial structures that, if leveraged appropriately, can be beneficial. Therefore, building upon existing prompt-based Interpretable Transformers, we design a new framework that addresses two key concerns: 1 1 ) enabling prompting strategies in prompt-based Interpretable Transformers to adapt to both natural and specialized image inputs while keeping the pretrained backbone intact; and 2 2 ) providing meaningful interpretations while simultaneously achieving high classification accuracy.
blocks.zh: 这突出表明,无论输入图像类型如何,都需要可解释的变形器,有效处理分类性能和可解释性之间的权衡。 现有模型的局限性来自冷冻骨干,这限制了诱因真正适应。 然而,这些主干线仍然编码有用的空间结构,如果加以适当利用,将是有益的。 因此,在现有即时可解释变压器的基础上,我们设计了一个新的框架,解决两个关键问题:1)能够促使迅速可解释变压器采用战略,适应自然和专门图像输入,同时保持预先训练过的骨干完好无损;2)提供有意义的解释,同时实现高分类准确性。

blocks.en: Recent advances in Vision Transformers (ViTs) [ 9 ] have significantly improved visual recognition, particularly for fine-grained analysis [ 42 , 37 , 46 , 13 ] . Self-supervised models such as DINO [ 3 ] , DINOv2 [ 30 ] , and DINOv3 [ 36 ] , trained on large-scale natural image datasets, exhibit strong object-level localization capabilities. Therefore, these self-supervised models constitute strong backbone candidates, as they provide semantically meaningful representations that are well suited for interpretable Transformers.
blocks.zh: 近期在视觉变形器(ViTs)[9]中的进步大大改善了视觉识别,特别是用于精细分析[42,37,46,13]. DINO[3],DINOv2[30],DINOv3[36]等自控模型,接受大型自然影像数据集培训,显示出强大的物体级本地化能力. 因此,这些自我监督的模式构成了强大的骨干候选人,因为它们提供了非常有意义的表述,非常适合可解释的变革者。

blocks.en:
To this end, we propose INTR++, which aims to perform well across domains irrespective of input type while simultaneously improving both accuracy and interpretability. INTR++ builds upon Prompt-CAM by introducing a lightweight adapter module that enhances adaptability and classification performance without compromising interpretability. The introduced Prompt Adapter Module (PAM) is strategically integrated to enrich the prompts with domain-specific knowledge while making only minimal adjustments to the pretrained backbone representations. Other adapter approaches such as LoRA [ 14 ] and AdaptFormer [ 5 ] introduce adapter components for domain generalization; however, their designs limit the ability to align prompt representations with salient input characteristics in interpretability-driven settings.
Pls. refer to Figure 3 for more details.
blocks.zh:
为此,我们提议INTR++,其目的是不分输入类型,在各领域都表现良好,同时提高准确性和可解释性。 INTR++通过引入轻量级适配器模块,在不损害可解释性的情况下增强适应性和分类性能,从而在即时-CAM的基础上发展. 引入的即时适配器模块(PAM)在战略上进行了整合,以丰富具有特定领域知识的提示,同时对预先培训的骨干表示只做最小的调整. 其他适配器方法如LORA [14] 和AdaptFormer [5] 引入适配器组件用于域泛化;然而,其设计限制了在可解释性驱动的设置中将即时表示与显著输入特性相匹配的能力.
Pls. 详见图3.

blocks.en: The Prompt Adapter integrated into INTR++ enriches the prompt representations by incorporating domain-specific knowledge, while introducing only minimal residual adjustments to the backbone patch representations, thereby preserving the pretrained visual representations. The details of the introduced adapter module are illustrated in Figure 2 . The module is inserted into each transformer layer and operates on the intermediate token representations. A linear transformation followed by a non-linear activation enables the extraction of domain-specific features. The cross-attention mechanism between prompt tokens and image patches facilitates the integration of salient domain-specific characteristics into the prompts, thereby enabling INTR++ to deliver accurate predictions alongside meaningful interpretability across diverse domains.
blocks.zh: 并入INTR++的即时适配器通过纳入特定域的知识来丰富即时的表达方式,同时对主干补丁表达方式只引入最小的剩余调整,从而保留了预先训练的视觉表达方式. 引入的适配器模块详情见图2。 模块被插入到每个变压器层中,并在中间的代号表示上运行. 线性转换后再进行非线性激活,可以提取域特定特征. 快速符和图像补丁之间的交叉注意机制有利于将显著的域特异性融入提示,从而使INTR++能够提供准确的预测,同时在不同领域进行有意义的解释。

blocks.en: INTR++ addresses the challenges in existing prompt-based Interpretable Transformers by incorporating a lightweight module that enhances accuracy, interpretability and adaptability while keeping the model computationally efficient. It also addresses the trade-off between accuracy and interpretability. We extensively evaluate INTR++ on ten datasets across a diverse range of domains: Animal: [ 40 , 18 ] ; Plant: [ 29 , 34 ] ; Object-centric: [ 20 , 24 ] ; Medical imaging: [ 28 , 1 ] ; Microscopic imaging: [ 45 , 19 ] ; Remote sensing imagery: [ 43 , 7 ] . Our contributions are two-fold.
blocks.zh: INTR++通过纳入一个轻量级模块,提高准确性,可解释性和适应性,同时保持模型的计算效率,解决了现有快速基可解释变换器的挑战. 它还涉及准确性和可解释性之间的权衡。 我们在10个不同领域的数据集上对INTR++进行了广泛的评价:动物:[40,18];植物:[29,34];以物体为中心的:[20,24];医学成像:[28,1];微观成像:[45,19];遥感成像:[43,7]。 我们的贡献是双重的。

blocks.en: • We introduce a lightweight Prompt Adapter Module (PAM), that enhances accuracy and interpretability while enabling effective domain adaptability across both natural and specialized images. • We demonstrate the effectiveness of INTR++ through extensive experiments on datasets spanning domains with both natural and specialized image characteristics. INTR++ also effectively handles the trade-off between accuracy and interpretability observed in existing prompt-based approaches. The source code is available at https://github.com/dipanjyoti/INTR-PlusPlus .

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: Figure 2 : Architecture of INTR++. INTR++ employs a pretrained frozen backbone, while learning only the prompts and a lightweight prompt adapter module. The module is simple, adding only a small number of additional parameters. It consists of a lower-dimensional linear projection, a non-linear activation, self-attention over prompt tokens, cross-attention with image patches, and a projection back to the original dimension. The adapted prompt tokens at the last layer are finally used for classification. See the Method section for details.
blocks.zh: 图2:INTR++的架构. INTR++使用预先训练的冷冻骨干,同时只学习提示和轻量级的快速适配模块. 模块简单,只增加了少量附加参数. 它包括一个下维线性投影,一个非线性激活,自觉凌驾于迅速的符号之上,带有图像补丁的交叉投影,以及投影回原维. 最后一层的调整后的即时符号最终用于分类. 详情见方法一节。

blocks.en: Meaningful interpretation is crucial for fine-grained tasks in domains such as biodiversity and healthcare. Early works focused on post-hoc explainability, where predictions are retrospectively analyzed to identify influential regions. Grad-CAM [ 35 ] , Layer-CAM [ 16 ] , Eigen-CAM [ 26 ] , Attention Roll-out [ 17 ] , GradCAM++ [ 4 ] , Ablation-CAM [ 33 ] , and XGradCAM [ 10 ] generate saliency maps using gradients. However, these methods often lack trustworthiness as they explain decisions only after the prediction is made.
blocks.zh: 有意义的解释对于在生物多样性和保健等领域完成精细任务至关重要。 早期的作品侧重于热后解释性,其中对预测进行了回顾性分析,以确定有影响力的区域. Grad-CAM [35],Lyetle-CAM [16],Eigen-CAM [26],注意推出 [17],GradCAM++ [4],Ablation-CAM [33],和XGradCAM [10] 使用梯度生成显著地图. 然而,这些方法往往缺乏可信度,因为它们只是在作出预测后才解释决定。

blocks.en: In contrast, interpretable methods identify key attributes during the prediction process itself. Methods such as ProtoPFormer [ 44 ] , TesNet [ 41 ] , ProtoConcepts [ 23 ] , ProtoViT [ 22 ] , and PIPNet [ 27 ] use prototype-based reasoning to generate interpretations. However, they typically require complex architectures and multi-stage training, which limit their adaptability, applicability, and reproducibility.
blocks.zh: 相比之下,可解释方法在预测过程本身中识别关键属性. ProtoPFormer[44],TesNet[41],ProtoConcepts[23],ProtoViT[22],PIPNet[27]等方法使用原型推理生成解释. 然而,它们通常需要复杂的架构和多阶段培训,这限制了它们的适应性、适用性和可复制性。

blocks.en: To address these challenges, a new line of work, namely Interpretable Transformers , including INTR [ 31 ] and Prompt-CAM [ 6 ] , has been proposed. The core idea is to provide meaningful interpretation using standard architectures and end-to-end learning objectives. However, these methods are tightly coupled with the backbone and struggle to generalize to specialized image inputs. Moreover, these models suffer from a trade-off between accuracy and interpretability. Additionally, the prompts in Prompt-CAM are static in nature, which limits their adaptability when applied to domains beyond natural images. Therefore, there is a need for adaptive prompts.
blocks.zh: 为应对这些挑战,提出了一个新的工作领域,即可解释的变换器,包括INTR[31]和Sumple-CAM[6]。 核心思想是利用标准架构和端到端的学习目标提供有意义的解释. 然而,这些方法与骨干结合紧密,并努力将图像投入普遍化。 此外,这些模型在准确性和可解释性之间有权衡。 此外,即时-CAM中的提示是静态的,这限制了它们在适用于自然图像以外的领域时的适应性。 因此,需要有适应性的提示。

blocks.en: Recent works on domain adaptation, such as AdaptFormer [ 5 ] , LoRA [ 14 ] , and DVPT [ 12 ] , attempt to address cross-domain challenges. However, the designs of AdaptFormer and LoRA are not suitable for refining prompt representations to better capture salient input characteristics. In contrast, DVPT relies on the [CLS] token, which limits its ability to capture class-specific attributes.
blocks.zh: 最近关于域域适应的著作,如AdaptFormer [5],LORA [14],以及DVPT [12],试图应对跨域挑战. 然而,AdaptFormer和LORA的设计并不适合完善即时表示以更好地捕捉显著输入特性. 相比之下,DVPT依赖于[CLS]符号,这限制了它捕捉类特定属性的能力.

blocks.en: 3 Method
blocks.zh: 3 方法

blocks.en: In this paper, we introduce INTR++ , an Interpretable Transformer framework inspired by Prompt-CAM [ 6 ] and Visual Prompt Tuning (VPT) [ 15 ] , which incorporates a lightweight Prompt Adapter Module (PAM). The overall architecture remains simple, as the adapter can be easily integrated into transformer layers while fully leveraging the backbone model. The architecture is illustrated in Figure 2 . For clarity, we follow the same naming conventions and notation as Prompt-CAM.
blocks.zh: 在本文中,我们介绍INTR++,这是一个由Expony-CAM [6]和Visual Fair Tuning (VPT) [15] 启发的可解释变速器框架,其中包含了一个轻量级的Fairdate module(PAM). 整体架构依然简单,因为适配器可以轻松地融入变压器层,同时充分利用骨干模型. 图2显示了这一架构。 为了明确起见,我们遵循与Power-CAM相同的命名惯例和标记。

blocks.en: 3.2 Overall Workings of INTR++
blocks.zh: 3.2 INTR++的总体工作

blocks.en: INTR++ is built on the deep variants of Prompt-CAM [ 6 ] . It leverages pretrained ViT backbones for classification. The PAM is integrated into each layer of the backbone model. While the backbone is kept frozen, PAM remains learnable. Additionally, for a dataset with C C classes, INTR++ introduces C C learnable class-specific prompt vectors, each of dimension D D . The prompts are injected at each layer and learned independently. Prompts from the final layer are used as class-specific tokens for prediction.
blocks.zh: INTR++基于Plain-CAM[6]的深变体. 它利用预先训练的ViT骨干进行分类. PAM集成于每层骨干模型中. 虽然骨干被冻结,但PAM仍然可以学习. 此外,对于带有C类的数据集,INTR++引入了C可学习类特定快速向量,每个维度D. 提示在每一层注入并独立学习. 从末层发出的提示作为特定等级的符号用于预测.

blocks.en: Given a labeled training example ( 𝑰 , y ∈ { 1 , ⋯ , C } ) (\bm{I},y\in\{1,\cdots,C\}) , unlike traditional ViT classifiers [ 8 , 21 ] , INTR++ relies on class-specific prompts injected at the last layer, denoted as 𝑷 N − 1 = [ 𝒑 1 , ⋯ , 𝒑 C ] \bm{P}_{N-1}=[\bm{p}^{1},\cdots,\bm{p}^{C}] , and produces class-specific outputs 𝒁 N = [ 𝒛 N 1 , ⋯ , 𝒛 N C ] \bm{Z}_{N}=[{\bm{z}}_{N}^{1},\cdots,{\bm{z}}_{N}^{C}] . blocks.en: Figure 3 illustrates the cosine similarity between token representations before and after adapter insertion. As shown, the MLP substantially disrupts the backbone representations, making it unsuitable for prompt adaptation. In contrast, LoRA, PromptAdapter, and INTR++ introduce only minimal adjustments to the backbone image patch representations, thereby preserving the pretrained visual representations. Notably, INTR++ yields significantly richer prompt representations than LoRA and AdaptFormer, suggesting more effective incorporation of domain-specific knowledge. This behavior indicates that the Prompt Adapter Module (PAM) acts as a controlled residual correction mechanism, selectively enriching the prompt representations without substantially perturbing the pretrained backbone representations, making INTR++ well suited for adaptation across both natural and specialized image domains.

blocks.en: As shown in Equation 3 , the model predicts the score for class c c using the class-specific prompt output 𝒛 N c {\bm{z}}_{N}^{c} . Since the projection vector 𝒘 \bm{w} is shared across all prompts, it does not introduce any class-specific bias. This design encourages each prompt to encode distinctive features relevant to its class, making them inherently discriminative.

blocks.en: By analyzing 𝒛 N c {\bm{z}}_{N}^{c} , we can thus identify which features the model relies on for predicting class c c . To provide interpretability, we examine the multi-head attention weights in the final transformer layer. Specifically, we extract the attention maps between each class-specific prompt and the image patch tokens. These maps are then superimposed on the input image to highlight the regions most influential to the model’s prediction. This serves as supporting visual evidence for model interpretability. Like Prompt-CAM , we greedily select top attention heads that are sufficient to distinguish between different categories, and visualize only those in the experiment section.

blocks.en: 4.1 Experimental Setup

blocks.en: Dataset. We extensively evaluate the performance and adaptability of INTR++ across diverse datasets spanning both natural image domains and specialized image domains . The natural image domains include Animal: CUB-200-2011 ( CUB ) [ 40 ] and Stanford Dogs ( Dog ) [ 18 ] ; Plant: Oxford Flowers ( Flower ) [ 29 ] and Medicinal Leaf ( MedLeaf ) [ 34 ] ; and Object-centric: Stanford Cars ( Car ) [ 20 ] and FGVC Aircraft ( Craft ) [ 24 ] . The specialized image domains include Medical: MRI Brain Tumors ( Brain ) [ 28 ] and Gallbladder Cancer Ultrasound ( GBCU ) [ 1 ] ; Microscopic: Colon Cancer Whole Slide Imaging ( Colon ) [ 45 ] ; and Remote Sensing: Aerial Image Dataset ( AID ) [ 43 ] . More in the Suppl. Sec. A.2 .
blocks.zh: 数据集. 我们广泛评价包括自然图像域和专业图像域在内的各种数据集的INTR++的性能和适应性。 自然形象域包括:动物:CUB-200-2011(CUB)[40]和斯坦福狗(狗)[18];植物:牛津花(花)[29]和美第奇叶(美第奇叶)[34];以及以对象为中心的:斯坦福汽车(汽车)[20]和FGVC Aircraft(工艺)[24]. 专业形象领域包括医学:核磁共振脑肿瘤(大脑)[28]和Gallbladder癌超声波(GBCU)[1];微镜: 科隆癌症 全幻灯片成像(Colon)[45];和遥感:空中图像数据集(AID)[43]. 更多在补编。 A.2节

The backbone is kept frozen in INTR++, while only the prompts, PAM, and the classification head are learned. More in the Suppl. Sec. A.3 .

Baselines. We compare INTR++ with several baseline methods. We show comparison with the interpretable methods like TesNet [ 41 ] , ProtoConcepts [ 23 ] , PIPNet [ 27 ] , ProtoViT [ 22 ] and Prompt-CAM [ 6 ] . Additionally, we compare with post-hoc methods such as Grad-CAM [ 35 ] , Layer-CAM [ 16 ] , Eigen-CAM [ 26 ] , and Attention Roll-out [ 17 ] .
Finally, to evaluate the contribution of the integrated adaptive module, we compare INTR++ with adaptation based approaches like LoRA [ 14 ] and AdaptFormer [ 5 ] .

blocks.en: 4.2 Overall Performance of INTR++
blocks.zh: 4.2 INTR++的总体性能

blocks.en:
INTR++ has been extensively evaluated across datasets from diverse domains, demonstrating its effectiveness in three key aspects: improved accuracy, better interpretability and adaptability. As shown in INTR++: INterpretable TRansformer with better Accuracy, Interpretability, and Adaptability , the model consistently provides meaningful interpretations regardless of the domain. For biodiversity tasks, it identifies discriminative traits, while in medical imaging, it highlights relevant regions of interest.
Furthermore, the improved classification performance of INTR++ is evidenced by its gains over Prompt-CAM in Table 2 , while its superior interpretability is illustrated in Figure 8 . More in the Suppl. Sec. C.1 .
blocks.zh:
INTR++在来自不同领域的数据集中得到了广泛的评价,在三个关键方面显示出其有效性:提高准确性、更好的可解释性和适应性。 如INTR++所示:具有更好的准确性、可解释性和可适应性的Interpressable TRansformer,该模型无论领域如何,始终提供有意义的解释。 就生物多样性任务而言,它确定了歧视性特征,而在医学成像中,它突出了相关感兴趣的区域。
此外,INTR++的分类性能得到改善,这表现在表2中它比Power-CAM的增益,而其优异的可解释性如图8所示。 更多见补编C.1节。

blocks.en: 4.3 Performance on Specialized Image Domains

blocks.en: The GBCU dataset is used as the primary reference to demonstrate the effectiveness of our approach, while similar trends hold across the other specialized image datasets.
blocks.zh: GBCU数据集被作为显示我们方法有效性的主要参考,而类似的趋势则贯穿其他专门图像数据集。

blocks.en: Expert evaluation. We conducted a human evaluation on the heatmaps generated by INTR++. For the GBCU dataset, we randomly selected 10 images from the malignant and benign categories and collected corresponding heatmaps from INTR++, Prompt-CAM , Attention Rollout, and LayerCAM. These heatmaps were shared with five medical experts without disclosing the method used. The results show that INTR++ accurately localized the region of interest in 91% of the cases, compared to 73% for Prompt-CAM , 69% for Attention Rollout, and 47% for LayerCAM. This highlights the effectiveness of INTR++.
blocks.zh: 专家评价。 我们对INTR++产生的热图进行了人类评估。 对于GBCU数据集,我们从恶性和良性分类中随机选择了10个图像,并收集了INTR++, Sumple-CAM, 注意推出, 和图层CAM的相应热图. 这些热图是与五名医学专家分享的,但没有披露所使用的方法。 结果显示,INTR++精确地将91%的病例所涉区域本地化,而即时CAM为73%,关注推出为69%,层CAM为47%。 这凸显了INTR++的有效性.

blocks.en: INTR++ for trait manipulation. We validate the importance of the highlighted traits through an attribute manipulation analysis. Specifically, we select an input image of a White-necked Raven from the CUB dataset as in Figure 6 . During prediction, the model highlights the white neck as an important trait for this species. Next, we manually edit the image to remove this trait following [ 38 , 2 ] , as shown in the second row. The model then predicts American Crow, which indeed resembles the modified image. This demonstrates that INTR++ actually relies on such traits for species identification. We perform a similar attribute manipulation for medical tasks. More in the Suppl. Sec. B.6 .

blocks.en: INTR++ vs. Prompt-CAM. INTR++ builds upon Prompt-CAM to enhance interpretability and extend applicability across domains, including specialized input domains. Figure 8 illustrates a comparison between INTR++ and Prompt-CAM . INTR++ demonstrates substantial improvements in the medical imaging, microscopic imaging performing consistently across diverse imaging modalities, MRI, WSI, and ultrasound. For biodiversity and other tasks, both models perform comparably, although INTR++ offers slightly clearer interpretations. Furthermore, INTR++ yields correct predictions and interpretations in cases where Prompt-CAM fails, underscoring its cross-domain effectiveness. More in the Suppl. Sec. B.2 , B.4 and B.5 .

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en:
In this paper, we proposed an interpretable transformer method, INTR++, which introduces a lightweight adaptive component, Prompt Adapter that enriches the prompts, to jointly improve prediction accuracy, interpretability, and model adaptability. INTR++ effectively resolves the trade-off between accuracy and interpretability.
Moreover, it demonstrates strong adaptability across domains, performing consistently well on both natural and specialized image domains, thereby highlighting its generalizability.
blocks.zh:
在本文中,我们提出了一种可解释的变压器方法INTR++,它引入了轻量级适应组件,即能丰富提示的即时适应器,共同提高预测的准确性,可解释性,以及模型的适应性. INTR++有效解决了准确性和可解释性之间的权衡.
此外,它显示出各个领域的高度适应性,在自然和专门形象领域都表现良好,从而突出其普遍性。

blocks.en: A.1 Adapter Modules

blocks.en: In this section, we provide the architectural details of the adapter module AdaptFormer [ 5 ] . Please see Figure 11 . This module operates by considering all input tokens without giving any special treatment to the prompt tokens. It processes image patches and prompt tokens equally. In contrast, INTR++ passes the prompt tokens through attention mechanisms, enabling them to learn domain-specific knowledge via cross-attention with the image patches. We set the projection dimension of the bottleneck layer to 64 64 for all the approaches, including INTR++, AdaptFormer [ 5 ] , and LoRA [ 14 ] , as this setting yields the best performance.
blocks.zh: 在本节中,我们提供了适配器模块"适配器"[5]的建筑细节. 请见图11。 本模块的运作方式是考虑所有输入符,而不给及时符以任何特殊待遇. 它同样处理图像补丁和提示符. 相比之下,INTR++通过关注机制传递了即时符号,使他们能够通过图像补丁的交叉注意来学习特定域的知识. 我们把瓶颈层的投影层面设定为64 64, 包括INTR++、AdaptFormer [5] 和LORA [14], 因为这种设定产生最佳业绩。

blocks.en: We comprehensively evaluate the performance on datasets from both natural and specialized image domains. The specialized image datasets include the Medical imaging domain: MRI Brain Tumors ( Brain ) [ 28 ] and Gallbladder Cancer Ultrasound ( GBCU ) [ 1 ] ; the Microscopic imaging domain: Colon Cancer Whole Slide Imaging ( Colon ) [ 45 ] ; and the Remote Sensing imagery domain: Aerial Image Dataset ( AID ) [ 43 ] . blocks.en: A.3 Model
blocks.zh: A.3 模式

blocks.en: We mostly followed the implementation details of Prompt-CAM [ 6 ] . For all medical and microscopic imaging datasets, along with MedLeaf, training was conducted for 50 epochs, whereas the remaining datasets were trained for 120 epochs. We used the Stochastic Gradient Descent (SGD) optimizer with a momentum of 0.9 0.9 . A weight decay of 0.0 0.0 was used for all datasets. For the medical and microscopic imaging datasets, we used a learning rate of 0.03 0.03 with a batch size of 128 128 , whereas for the remaining datasets, we used a learning rate of 0.01 0.01 with a batch size of 16 16 .
blocks.zh: 我们主要关注《快速-CAM》的实施细节。 对所有医疗和微型成像数据集以及MedLeaf进行了培训,培训对象为50个纪元,其余数据集的培训对象为120个纪元。 我们使用了Stochastic Gradient Engen(SGD)优化器,动力为0.9 0.9. 所有数据集的重量衰减为0.0。 对于医疗和显微成像数据集,我们使用的学习率为0.03 0.03,批量大小为128 128,而对于其余数据集,我们使用的学习率为0.01 0.01,批量大小为16 16。

blocks.en: We provide the interpretation results of INTR++ in Figure 13 . blocks.en: B.6 Attribute Manipulation
blocks.zh: B.6 属性操纵

blocks.en: We validate the importance of the highlighted regions in medical imaging through attribute manipulation analysis. Specifically, we select a malignant tumor image from the GBCU dataset and identify its critical region using INTR++, as shown in Figure 17 . We then manually edit the image to remove the identified cancerous region and re-evaluate it using the model. The modified image is subsequently classified as normal, demonstrating the precision and significance of the region identified by INTR++.
blocks.zh: 我们通过属性操纵分析,验证突出区域在医学成像中的重要性。 具体来说,我们从GBCU数据集中选择一个恶性肿瘤图像,并使用INTR++识别其临界区域,如图17所示. 然后我们手动编辑图像,去除已确认的癌区,并使用模型重新评价. 修改后的图像随后被归类为普通图像,显示了INTR++所确定的区域的精度和意义.

blocks.en: Additionally, we quantitatively analyze this study by considering a few species from the CUB dataset. We randomly selected 10 images each from the Red-winged Blackbird, Baltimore Oriole, and White-necked Raven classes and manually manipulated them to resemble American Crow, Orchard Oriole, and American Crow, respectively. The trait manipulation was performed following the guidelines from Cornell Lab 1 1 1 https://www.birds.cornell.edu/home and Birds of the World 2 2 2 https://birdsoftheworld.org/bow/home . We passed both the original and manipulated images through INTR++, Prompt-CAM , and PIP-Net and observed that the models correctly identified the manipulated traits with accuracies of 97.7%, 97.7%, and 90.0%, respectively. We consider a manipulated trait to be correctly detected if the model predicts the target category corresponding to the manipulated image.
blocks.zh: 此外,我们通过考虑CUB数据集中的一些物种,对这项研究进行定量分析。 我们随机从红翼黑鸟,巴尔的摩·奥里奥尔,和白颈雷文课中各选取10幅图像,并手动操纵,分别与美国乌鸦,果园奥里奥尔和美国乌鸦相似. 根据康奈尔实验室11号准则进行特性操纵。 我们通过INTR++、Sune-CAM和PIP-Net将原始和被操纵的图像传递过来,并观察到这些模型正确确定了被操纵的特征,分别为97.7%、97.7%和90.0%。 我们认为,如果模型预测的目标类别与被操纵的图像相对应,就会正确检测出被操纵的特征。

blocks.en: C.3 Interpretation of INTR++ Across Backbones
blocks.zh: C.3 INTR++的解释 横跨后骨

blocks.en: A key strength of INTR++ is its robustness across different backbone models. In this work, we primarily use the DINO backbone for analysis. However, we also evaluate INTR++ with other backbones, including DINOV2 [ 30 ] and BioCLIP2 [ 11 ] . Table 3 reports the classification accuracy on the CUB, Car, Flower, GBCU, Colon and AID datasets for each backbone. The observed performance improvements are primarily attributed to the backbone models being pre-trained on larger datasets, while the interpretability of INTR++ remains consistent regardless of the backbone. As shown in Figure 9 , which presents interpretation results for the Heermann Gull species from the CUB dataset, INTR++ consistently identifies distinct discriminative traits irrespective of the backbone.

blocks.en: D.2 Role of Gate g
blocks.zh: D.2 G门的作用

blocks.en: Each adapter output is integrated into the backbone through a learnable gating parameter, g, which controls the fraction of the adapter information added to the original transformer output. A gate value of 0 reduces the model to Prompt-CAM, while a gate value of 1 fully incorporates the adapter output. The gate is initialized to g=1, allowing full adapter contribution during the early stages of training to facilitate effective domain alignment. As training progresses, g is learned jointly with the adapter parameters and gradually decreases, converging to a stable value. This behavior indicates that the model initially relies on stronger adaptive corrections and subsequently attenuates the adapter contribution as the representations become aligned, resulting in controlled and stable integration without overwhelming the pretrained backbone. Please refer to Figure 4 for the CUB dataset. Additionally, Figure 20 shows the gate scores over the training epochs for the GBCU dataset.
blocks.zh: 每个适配器输出都通过一个可学习的配位参数g整合到主干线中,该参数控制了在原变压器输出中添加的适配器信息的一小部分. 0的闸门值将模型降低为Poun-CAM,而1的闸门值则完全融入适配器输出. 闸机初始化为g=1,允许在培训初期充分适配器贡献,以便于有效域对齐. 随着培训的进展,g与适配器参数一起学习,并逐渐减少,趋同到稳定值. 这种行为表明,模型最初依赖于更强的适应性校正,随后随着表达方式的趋同而减弱了适配器的贡献,从而在不压倒预先训练的骨干的情况下,实现控制下的稳定整合. CUB数据集请参见图4. 此外,图20显示GBCU数据集的大门分数超过培训时代。

blocks.en: D.4 Comparisons among Different Adapters
blocks.zh: D.4 不同适应者的比较

blocks.en: We analyze the adaptive behavior of different adapter designs, including MLP, LoRA, AdaptFormer, and PAM (INTR++), using the cosine similarity between backbone-only and adapter-augmented representations. Across all methods, image patch tokens exhibit high similarity to the backbone representations, except for MLP, which disrupts the pretrained representations as illustrated in Figure 3 . In contrast, prompt-wise analysis reveals that PAM induces larger representational shifts between the backbone-only and adapter-augmented representations. This behavior arises from the design of PAM, which explicitly aligns prompts with salient input characteristics through prompt-centric interactions. LoRA and AdaptFormer, on the other hand, produce prompt representations that remain closer to the original backbone representations. As a result, PAM not only adaptively adjusts the pretrained representations but also enables the prompts to better capture input characteristics, leading to improved adaptability across both natural and specialized image domains while enhancing accuracy and interpretability. Figure 22 additionally illustrates the poor interpretability of MLP-based adapters, which capture noise and only a single attribute across different heads.
blocks.zh: 我们分析不同适配器设计的适应行为,包括MLP,LORA,AdaptFormer,和PAM(INTR++),使用仅主干和适配器增强的表示之间的余弦相似性. 在所有方法中,图像补丁符号与骨干表示高度相似,但MLP除外,它干扰了图3所示的预先训练过的表示. 相比之下,快速分析显示,PAM在主干和适配器增强的表述之间诱发更大的代表性转变。 这种行为源于PAM的设计,它通过即时-中心交互,将提示与显著的输入特性明确对齐. 另一方面,LORA和AdaptFormer则产生与原始骨干代表关系更加密切的即时表述. 因此,PAM不仅适应性地调整了预先训练过的表示方式,而且使提示能更好地捕捉输入特性,从而在提高准确性和可解释性的同时,改善自然和专门图像领域的适应性。 图22还说明了基于MLP的适配器的不易解释性,这些适配器捕捉到噪音,并且只在不同的头之间有一个单一的属性.
